 We have had an enjoyable and sunny workweek, and it will continue right through this weekend!
Friday was Syracuse's sixth consecutive dry day and that pattern continues at least through this weekend. 
 It's part of our next weather makers :
 Central New York's next weather makers 
As I have been telling you much of this week, you should absolutely take advantage of the very quiet conditions ahead by getting outside! Whether it is going for a walk, getting your leaves raked, getting some yard work done or possibly even putting up some Halloween or early December holiday decorations up, you should definitely get outside while the weather is about as good as it gets this time of year!
 Here is your "Rake or Wait"(or decoration put up) forecast :
 Your "Rake or Wait" forecast for the next 4 days 
As shown above, there are only two opportunities for any sprinkles or showers over the next 7 days and nights. The first chance would be Monday afternoon. The best chance would be across the North Country and the Adirondacks. However, as this system moves from north to south across Central New York Monday afternoon, I cannot completely rule out a sprinkle or brief shower in Syracuse and Central New York. However, the air continues to be very dry on Monday. So, it is very possible this next weak system comes through dry.
Despite very little moisture from Monday's system, there is some cooler air behind it that will move in for Tuesday. That will bring our coolest high temperature over the next 7 days before high temperatures once again increase.
The other weak system that will give us another chance at some spotty showers would be at some point late next Thursday afternoon through Friday morning. Yet again, this system does not have a lot of moisture with it. So, I am not expecting widespread heavy rain from it.
